# Cargo: name the feed as a registry (.cargo/config.toml)
# A sparse index (Cargo 1.68 and later). Nothing comes from it unless a dependency names it with registry =.
[registries.acme]
index = "sparse+https://pkg.plrs.im/cargo/acme/"

# Cargo: the registry token
# Cargo 1.74 and later send it on every request to a feed whose config.json says auth-required.
export CARGO_REGISTRIES_ACME_TOKEN="$PKEY_REGISTRY_TOKEN"

# Depend on the crate from this registry (Cargo.toml)
[dependencies]
acme-sdk = { version = "*", registry = "acme" }
